page_title: CEL 0-1 ATM | Celta Vigo v Atletico Madrid 26/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Rough tackle by Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' The current number of shots on goal is 4:2.
90+2' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' 0 - 1 Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) meets a perfect cross from Antoine Griezmann deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 0:1.

89' Ambitious effort from Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
87' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
84' Hugo Sotelo will be replaced by Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
84' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Nahuel Molina and he is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
84' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Iago Aspas as he is replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
83' The attendance for today's match is 21533.
81' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
80' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

80' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the bottom left corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Vicente Guaita. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

78' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
76' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to discuss the decision with Victor Garcia, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
76' Substitution. Borja Iglesias makes way for Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
74' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Jan Oblak is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
73' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
70' Here is a change. Javier Manquillo is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
70' That will be all from Williot Swedberg who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo).
69' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and Victor Garcia immediately signals a free kick.
68' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
65' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) replaces Giuliano Simeone.
65' Substitution. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) replaces Alexander Sorloth.
64' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
64' Julian Alvarez is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
61' None of the Celta Vigo players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
57' A precise low pass is received by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
56' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Jan Oblak anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
56' A cross from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
55' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
54' Here comes a substitution. Koke is given a rest as he is replaced by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).
53' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
52' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
51' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Victor Garcia stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
49' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' 3:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
44' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) is penalised for a foul. Victor Garcia had a clear view and blows his whistle.
42' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Jan Oblak.
41' A spell of possession for Celta Vigo in an attempt to control the game.
38' Booking. Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) receives a caution from the referee.
37' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
37' A lofted cross from Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Celta Vigo get a corner.
34' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Vicente Guaita.
33' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) for his blatant foul.
31' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
29' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but Jan Oblak comes off his line to gather the ball.
28' The ball possession at the moment is 60:40.
23' Referee Victor Garcia sees the trip by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
22' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
21' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
17' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
17' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared. Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.
16' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) jumps into a tackle and Victor Garcia signals a foul. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick.
14' A player from Atl. Madrid takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
10' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) latches onto a short pass from Sergio Carreira inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the left post.
9' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid). Victor Garcia saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
7' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
6' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
5' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
3' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
2' A pass by Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
